items.verification: independent reviewer verifies identity evidence, validity and signer certificate scope; no self-report or local name is sufficient
items.recovery: named external witness supplies signed identity package and reviewer receipt; if owner/channel absent retain typed_absence/terminal_deferred

items.responsible_party: independent witness plus governance owner (external; currently typed_absence)
items.verification: reviewer checks role separation and signature over exact candidate/source scope; conflict or ambiguous scope is fail_closed
items.recovery: obtain a fresh signed disclosure from a distinct witness; any conflict or scope change invalidates the old receipt

required_fields: root public key or DER bytes
items.verification: pin caller-frozen anchor; independently verify root self-signature, policy, validity and scope; system-store roots are not acceptable
items.recovery: authority publishes a new externally pinned root package and fresh policy receipt; re-run path/revocation checks

items.verification: build and validate the complete path against the project root and profile; reject foreign, partial, expired or revoked chains
items.recovery: PKI owner returns a complete chain with fresh issuer and revocation evidence; changed chain requires a new signed receipt

items.responsible_party: independent witness; trusted-time/PKI authorities for supporting evidence (external; currently typed_absence)
items.verification: recompute canonical bytes and verify signature through EHP-02 chain, trusted time and revocation; scope or digest mismatch is fail_closed
items.recovery: re-sign exact canonical response with a valid external leaf and fresh time/revocation receipts; no local signature generation

items.verification: independent reviewer reruns the pinned verifier and checks profile/receipt/certificate algorithm equality; unsupported verifier is unavailable
items.recovery: publish a versioned, hash-pinned verifier/profile and fresh review receipt; policy changes invalidate prior acceptance

items.responsible_party: source authority and independent attestor (external; currently typed_absence)
items.verification: recompute all bytes/OIDs/digests from a fresh observed source; preserve dirty executor distinction and reject drift
items.recovery: source authority supplies complete signed closure for the same candidate; any source change rebuilds all downstream identities

items.verification: independent reviewer verifies owner, endpoint, transport, pin and channel policy before any send; unspecified endpoint stays typed_absence
items.recovery: channel owner publishes a verifiable contract and testable acknowledgement path; no request is sent before this

items.verification: verify signed ack binds the exact request/bundle and replay fields; missing or unsigned ack is typed_absence/fail_closed per condition
items.recovery: channel returns a fresh signed ack or signed rejection; retain raw response and never treat local spool receipt as authority

items.verification: join and recompute every edge; reject foreign, orphan, duplicate, cyclic or ambiguous lineage
items.recovery: authoritative party issues one complete same-candidate lineage package; rebuild downstream receipts after any edit

items.verification: caller-frozen digest plus independent path/policy verification; never infer from Windows/system stores
items.recovery: fresh out-of-band root and policy package; all dependent signatures must be revalidated

items.verification: path-build against pinned trust_root and verify every certificate signature/constraint
items.recovery: replace with a complete valid chain and new receipt; partial chain remains fail_closed

items.verification: verify leaf identity, EKU, key usage, chain, revocation and independence scope
items.recovery: new qualified attestor supplies a valid leaf and signed scope; old receipts expire on revocation

items.responsible_party: contract and verifier owner (external; currently typed_absence)
items.verification: profile-aware verifier checks certificate, receipt and declared algorithm are identical; aliases/unknown algorithms fail_closed
items.recovery: publish new versioned profile and re-sign all affected receipts

items.verification: canonicalize, hash, verify path/signature/time/revocation/replay and compare every cross-packet digest
items.recovery: issue a fresh receipt over unchanged or explicitly rebound bytes; no byte mutation is repair-in-place

items.verification: second process/environment reproduces the stated result and raw stdout/stderr/PID/UTC/exit receipt
items.recovery: provide a supported pinned verifier or classify as typed_absent/unsupported; never substitute local unit tests

items.verification: verify issuer signature, serial binding and freshness; revoked/unknown/stale/unavailable follows R2 fail-closed rules
items.recovery: fresh signed CRL/OCSP package with valid issuer and window; changed serial/issuer requires new receipt

items.verification: verify token imprint, policy, chain, trusted genTime and freshness; OS clock is never authority
items.recovery: obtain fresh independently verifiable time token bound to exact bytes

items.responsible_party: protocol and replay-ledger owner (external; currently typed_absence)
items.verification: independent checker verifies nonce uniqueness, sequence continuity, cross-scope reuse, CAS/ledger authentication and retry outcomes
items.recovery: new authorized request with fresh nonce under unchanged policy; key/policy change requires new anchor and receipt

items.responsible_party: source owners plus independent attestor (external; currently typed_absence)
items.verification: recompute bytes/OIDs and compare signed inventory; distinguish HEAD canonical files from dirty executor files
items.recovery: fresh signed inventory and rebuild candidate/axis/G2/receipt identities after drift

items.responsible_party: attestor and governance owner (external; currently typed_absence)
items.verification: reviewer distinct from all packet owners verifies scope completeness and no self-attestation
items.recovery: new distinct attestor signs a complete scope statement; expiry/conflict closes prior evidence

items.verification: recompute byte-for-byte bidirectional graph and reject orphan/duplicate/cycle/foreign edges
items.recovery: return a complete signed graph for one candidate and rebuild all downstream hashes

items.verification: validate exact mapping schema, interval, uniqueness, bidirectional edges and EHP-02 authority evidence
items.recovery: authority issues a fresh complete mapping; any policy/source change invalidates the old one

items.responsible_party: G1/G2/G3 axis owners plus independent authority (external; currently typed_absence)
items.verification: check exact four-axis set, hashes, versions, issuer/time/revocation/signature and same candidate across edges
items.recovery: obtain all four externally issued materials as one bound set; missing one keeps the set typed_absent

items.verification: recompute every declared file and dependency under a fixed root; validate signed outer envelope and caller-frozen expected_context
items.recovery: provider supplies complete candidate-bound closure; runtime/source/dependency drift requires rebind

items.responsible_party: binary publisher/distributor plus independent provenance reviewer (external; currently typed_absence)
required_fields: signed download receipt with origin/retrieval time
SPDX/CycloneDX SBOM refs and dependency edges
items.verification: verify binary signatures, receipt/recipe subject identity, SBOM exact coverage and licenses through the external trust chain
items.recovery: provider returns complete signed provenance or marks unavailable; no binary may be claimed covered by local Authenticode/store observation
